card.name: Citation punctuation and modal verbs
card.fires_on: Small marked words in running text: punctuation or digits inside journal citations (after year, volume), and modal verbs like might or can in old-style prose.

modes.label: Citation details
modes.description: Semicolon, period or space inside a journal reference between year, volume and page.

modes.label: Digits in ranges
modes.description: A zero partway through a number in a quantity or proof value.
modes.example: Assuming a daily intake of 40<<0>> to 1,000 mL

modes.label: Modal verbs in prose
modes.description: Words like might or can following a subject in literary or scholarly text.
modes.example: it<< might>> at least have been inferred that they had

card.writes: Promotes Chinese vocabulary like team and positive energy and suppresses odd fragments, so no coherent effect on English text.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting bits such as reference punctuation, number digits and words like might, with no single meaning.
